scenarios.name: complete-public-lifecycle
assertions: canonical cases are typed templates; runtime substitutes only owned trial identities and actual returned capabilities
one owner and one allocation span all members
local reap never appears as a socket operation

scenarios.name: original-ref-transfer-availability
assertions: A relinquishing or transferred source remains in complete status inventory with transfer_state and ready_for_acquisition=false.
The source initialization phase remains ready; availability is separate and never reconstructed by clearing a stopped lease.
No transfer response or historical replay grants a source writer; immutable seals and protected history remain separate evidence.
The optional response field adds no socket operation, remote authority or suite-consumer acceptance.

bindings.repository: owned fixture remotes, never production endpoints
bindings.lease_token: exact grant returned to that trial UID; never a holder label
bindings.source: exact confirmed checkpoint identity from the source trial
bindings.request_id: stable per trial UID/body; unchanged for replay
